sections.title: Combining descriptions
sections.content: You can combine identity, noun phrases and several adjectives to identify a person. Keep the same agreement rules when you add another adjective.

sections.title: Useful patterns
rows: Ana y Meg son jóvenes y simpáticas.

items.spanish: ¿Quién es Ana? Es una mujer joven y simpática.
items.english: Who is Ana? She is a young and friendly woman.

items.spanish: Carlos es un hombre alto y serio.
items.english: Carlos is a tall and serious man.

sections.content: Choose the adjective form that agrees with the person or noun you are describing. For further reference, see Lingolia's Spanish adjective agreement reference.
